headline: Afreximbank and APPO establish $5 billion Africa Energy Bank for oil and gas
summary: Afreximbank and the African Petroleum Producers' Organisation formally created the $5 billion Africa Energy Bank to finance oil and gas projects as Western lenders curb fossil fuel funding.
why: The Africa Energy Bank addresses an emerging financing vacuum for upstream energy infrastructure in Africa as multilateral and Western commercial banks pivot toward green energy.

impacts.name: African Energy Sector
impacts.why: The new $5 billion institution provides targeted capital for African oil and gas projects.
